categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Conglin Environmental Protection Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in hazardous waste treatment, focusing on harmless disposal and resource utilization. The company provides integrated environmental protection services including hazardous waste incineration, landfill, physical and chemical treatment, and recycling of hazardous waste into usable products. It serves upstream manufacturing industries by managing industrial hazardous waste and supports scientific research institutions with one-stop hazardous waste disposal services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed five core proprietary technologies including waste organic solvent resource utilization, hazardous waste incineration with slagging prevention and online cleaning, hazardous waste incineration flue gas low-cost collaborative treatment, deep purification and recycling of copper-containing waste liquid, and waste packaging container recycling technology. It employs advanced methods such as quantum chemistry simulations for solvent selection, ammonia thermal desorption, integrated hazardous waste incineration and purification systems, and automated liquid-phase processes. The company also innovates in equipment design for efficient and safe hazardous waste processing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading enterprises in information technology, high-end equipment manufacturing, new materials, new energy, and biopharmaceutical sectors, such as SMIC, Huahong Semiconductor, China Commercial Aircraft, China Aero Engine, Wanhua Chemical, Tesla (Shanghai), WuXi AppTec, and Fudan Zhangjiang. The company also serves numerous prestigious universities and research institutions, supporting scientific research and innovation. Its market covers industrial hazardous waste producers and scientific research entities requiring hazardous waste disposal.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Shanghai, Jiangsu, Shandong, and Shanxi provinces, with five major production and operation bases. It has established a national presence with regional technical centers and disposal facilities, focusing on economically developed eastern and central regions of China. The company’s projects and subsidiaries are distributed across these key regions to optimize hazardous waste treatment capacity and service coverage.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Conglin Technology operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the hazardous waste management supply chain. It receives hazardous waste from upstream manufacturing enterprises and research institutions, processes and treats the waste through disposal and resource recovery, and sells recycled products. The company also provides integrated hazardous waste management services including collection, storage, treatment, and recycling, positioning itself as a comprehensive hazardous waste treatment platform.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation with a focus on green, digital, and resource-efficient hazardous waste treatment. It maintains a provincial-level technology center and collaborates with top universities and research institutes to develop advanced treatment technologies and resource recovery processes. Current R&D projects include new processes for microelectronics waste phosphoric acid recycling, electronic-grade solvent production, precious metal recovery, lithium battery recycling, and hazardous waste information platform development. The company aims to enhance resource utilization efficiency, reduce environmental impact, and support national carbon neutrality goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through hazardous waste treatment service fees charged to upstream waste producers, including fees for harmless disposal and resource utilization. For waste with recycling value, the company also earns income from the sale of recycled products such as organic solvents, inorganic salts, base oils, heavy metals, and packaging containers. Some high-value recyclable waste is acquired at a cost or without service fees, depending on the arrangement. The company uses direct sales and has expanded sales channels to include internet and app-based platforms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in China's hazardous waste treatment industry, distinguished by its comprehensive technology portfolio, extensive regional presence, and strong customer base including major high-tech and manufacturing enterprises. The industry is fragmented with many small players; however, Conglin Technology’s advanced R&D capabilities, broad hazardous waste treatment qualifications, and integrated service model position it favorably against competitors. It actively participates in national and industry standards formulation, reinforcing its leadership role.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 634.8 million, a 13.42% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 88.36 million, down 49.5%. Total assets stood at RMB 3.29 billion with shareholders’ equity of RMB 2.66 billion. The company’s net asset return on equity was 3.17%. Despite recent revenue and profit declines due to market competition and industry overcapacity, the company maintains a solid asset base and continues investing in capacity expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Conglin Technology emphasizes its integrated hazardous waste treatment capabilities combining harmless disposal and resource utilization, supported by proprietary advanced technologies. Its unique value lies in providing comprehensive, safe, and environmentally compliant hazardous waste management solutions that reduce environmental risks and promote circular economy principles. The company’s technical innovation, extensive service network, and strong partnerships with leading industrial and research clients differentiate it as a reliable and innovative environmental protection service provider.
